comment: The DOCUMENTED baseline for incident_response — a Notion runbook last edited 2025-11-15 (stale). Each block has a stable `id` referenced by expected_attestations.json. This source is the 'documented_baseline' role: where it DISAGREES with observed Slack practice (escalation channel), the correct extractor must NOT let the doc win — it records both as a dispute. Where it AGREES with observed practice (postmortem policy), the claim is corroborated across doc + behavior.

blocks.heading: Escalation
blocks.text: All production incidents are escalated in #engineering. Page the on-call engineer via PagerDuty.

blocks.heading: Severity
blocks.text: P0 incidents require opening a war room and declaring a major incident.

blocks.heading: Postmortem
blocks.text: A postmortem is required for all P0 and P1 incidents and must be filed in Notion.
